item.title: Autonomous Drug Discovery: A Multimodal De Novo Generation & SE(3)-Equivariant Scoring Pipeline
item.description: An end-to-end multimodal drug discovery pipeline combining SELFIES-GPT de novo generation, D-MPNN/Transformer ADMET filtering, DiffDock-Pocket posing, and SE(3)-equivariant 3D binding affinity scoring.
